errors.evidence: The interval on the vertical axis is 20,000 but machine description incorrectly states 20 000.
Machine description lacks the title/caption: 'Календарно изгладени базисни индекси на произведените лекарствени вещества и продукти в България, 2021=100'.
Does not mention that December 2022 has the highest value surpassing 120,000 and July 2023 has the lowest value at about 80,000.
Fails to mention the consistent labeling and easy comparison feature by grouping the bars month-wise.
The vertical axis increments are actually at 20,000, not 20 as stated in the reference.
Does not mention that the vertical axis is labeled as '%' (percentage).
